import pulp

prob = pulp.LpProblem("maximize_rickshaws", pulp.LpMaximize)

# Decision variables
rickshaws = pulp.LpVariable("rickshaws", lowBound=0, cat="Integer")  # rickshaws
ox_carts = pulp.LpVariable("ox_carts", lowBound=0, cat="Integer")  # ox carts

# Objective: maximize number of coconuts
prob += 50 * rickshaws + 30 * ox_carts

# Constraints
prob += 10 * rickshaws + 8 * ox_carts <= 200  # at most 200
prob += rickshaws - ox_carts <= 0  # rickshaws not exceed ox carts

prob.solve(pulp.getSolver("HiGHS", msg=False))
print("Status:", pulp.LpStatus[prob.status])
print("Objective:", pulp.value(prob.objective))
print("rickshaws =", pulp.value(rickshaws))
print("ox_carts =", pulp.value(ox_carts))
